title: PerformanceStateMachine — 8 states, dual-threshold hysteresis, reopen
description:
Implement Source/DSP/PerformanceStateMachine as a real-time-safe 8-state performance engine with dual-threshold hysteresis and smooth Reopen (no allocations/locks/logging on the process path).

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md section 7 (states, T_close = T_open - H, soft decision region, Reopen)
- Source/DSP/DetectorEngine.* public API for L[n] / envelope inputs this machine will consume later
- Source/ParameterIDs.h threshold / hysteresis / hold-related IDs from phase A if present
- Existing Source/DSP/ header style (prepare/reset/process)

Implement PerformanceStateMachine.h/.cpp:
- States enum/order exactly: Closed, Primed, Attack, Open, Hold, Sustain, Release, Reopen.
- Dual-threshold hysteresis: compute T_close = T_open - H each update (H in [0.5, 24] dB); do NOT store a separate persisted T_close parameter.
- Open when L_open_score >= T_open. Remain open-family while L_sustain_score > T_close. Begin closing only when hold expired, sustain protection inactive, no valid reopen transient, and detector below closing condition.
- Primed: onset evidence not yet validated; may start open path early when lookahead flag/samples indicate pre-audio open is allowed (lookahead itself may be wired later — expose the API hook).
- Hold: detector fell below open threshold but minimum hold time not elapsed.
- Sustain: low level but sustain score / protection flag keeps musical note open (accept external sustain score / protection inputs; do not implement full Sustain Intelligence DSP here).
- Release: gain path should move toward floor (state only drives phase; GainComputer owns laws).
- Reopen: new valid transient during Release reverses the gain path smoothly without resetting gain to zero or inventing a discontinuity; expose current state + transition reason/flags for GainSmoother/computer consumers.
- Soft decision region helper (section 7.3): u = clamp((L - T_close)/(T_open - T_close), 0, 1); S(u) = 3u² - 2u³ usable as open certainty — hysteresis still owns discrete state.
- prepare(sampleRate)/reset(); process sample- or block-wise from detector dB level + optional transient/sustain inputs → current state + open certainty / should-open evidence. Realtime-safe.

Do NOT implement GainComputer/GainSmoother. Do NOT edit CMakeLists.txt or PluginProcessor (c.3 owns them). Do NOT write tests (c.4).

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: PerformanceStateMachine exposes the 8 states Closed, Primed, Attack, Open, Hold, Sustain, Release, Reopen
T_close is computed as T_open - H and is not stored as an independent parameter
Open path engages when L_open_score >= T_open and open-family states respect L_sustain_score > T_close hysteresis
Release supports Reopen on a valid transient without resetting the machine’s gain-path continuity contract (no forced gain-to-zero on reopen)
Soft-decision helper implements smoothstep S(u)=3u^2-2u^3 on the clamped dual-threshold region
No heap allocation in the per-block process path
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified

allowed: use plain C++20 + JUCE types already in the project
define PerformanceState enum and small status/flags structs in the machine headers
accept external transient and sustain-score inputs as floats/bools without owning those estimators
forbidden: implement full Pick Attack Guard, Sustain Intelligence, or Noise Learn inside this class
store T_close as a user parameter separate from T_open and H
